items.exampleEn: She casually mentioned that she was moving to Japan.
items.exampleZh: 她隨口提到她要搬去日本了。

items.exampleEn: The garden has a hybrid rose that smells of lemon.
items.exampleZh: 花園裡有一種聞起來像檸檬的混種玫瑰。

items.exampleEn: The calm water of the lake was reflective like a mirror.
items.exampleZh: 平靜的湖水像鏡子一樣反光。

items.exampleEn: Tie the rope loosely so the young tree can still grow.
items.exampleZh: 把繩子綁鬆一點，這樣小樹還能長大。

items.exampleEn: The first day of the sale was chaotic.
items.exampleZh: 特賣的第一天一片混亂。

items.exampleEn: Chocolate eggs are usually hollow inside.
items.exampleZh: 巧克力蛋裡面通常是空心的。

items.exampleEn: Please put your seat in the upright position before landing.
The news report was a distortion of what really happened.
items.exampleZh: 那篇新聞報導扭曲了真實發生的事。

items.sentenceEn: Life at home became chaotic when the twins were born.
items.sentenceZh: 雙胞胎出生後，家裡的生活變得一團亂。

items.audioEn: The shirt fits loosely, so it's comfortable on hot days.
items.audioZh: 這件襯衫穿起來很寬鬆，所以熱天穿很舒服。
items.questionZh: 為什麼這件襯衫熱天穿很舒服？
options: The shirt is made of thick cotton
It has short sleeves for hot days
It isn't tight on the body

items.sentenceEn: Stand upright and look at the camera, please.
The tree trunk was hollow, and a family of birds lived inside.
items.sentenceZh: 那棵樹的樹幹是空的，裡面住著一家鳥。

items.stemEn: This ____ class lets students join either in the room or online.
items.stemZh: 這門混合式課程讓學生可以選擇到教室或從網路上參加。

items.stemEn: The old mirror causes some ____, so your face looks wider than it is.
items.stemZh: 那面舊鏡子會讓影像有點變形，所以你的臉看起來比實際寬。

items.passageEn: Morning traffic in our city used to be chaotic, with cars, scooters and buses all fighting for space. The old buses could not cope with so many riders. Last year, the city bought fifty hybrid buses that use both electricity and gas. Each bus has reflective paint on its sides, so drivers can see it easily at night. Riders can bring their bikes on board, but they must keep them upright in a special corner. The drivers seem happier too, and many riders now chat casually with them. Some people said the plan would fail, but the numbers show that traffic is moving faster.
items.passageZh: 我們城市早上的交通以前很混亂，汽車、機車和公車都在搶空間。舊公車應付不了這麼多乘客。去年，市政府買了五十輛同時使用電和汽油的油電公車。每輛公車側面都塗了反光漆，駕駛在夜裡也能看得很清楚。乘客可以帶腳踏車上車，但必須把車直立放在一個特別的角落。司機們看起來也比較開心，現在很多乘客會隨意地和他們聊天。有些人說這個計畫會失敗，但數字顯示交通變得比較順暢了。

questions.questionZh: 新公車有什麼特別的設計？
options: 車身側面有夜裡看得清楚的反光漆
車上有免費的無線網路

questions.questionZh: 乘客帶腳踏車上車要怎麼放？
options: 拆開後放進車底的行李箱

items.promptZh: 這家公司的員工星期五可以穿得很隨意。
referenceEn: Employees at this company can dress casually on Fridays.
At this company, staff are allowed to dress casually on Fridays.
rubricZh: casually 修飾動詞（例如 dress casually 等）
「可以」可寫，例如 can、are allowed to 等

items.promptZh: 晚上騎腳踏車時，最好穿一件反光的外套。
referenceEn: You should wear a reflective jacket when you ride a bike at night.
When riding a bike at night, it is best to wear a reflective jacket.
rubricZh: reflective 放在名詞前（例如 a reflective jacket 等）
「最好」可寫，例如 should、it is best to、had better 等
when 子句可放句首或句尾
